trust_decision.summary: Stored record text (candidate/contact name, company name, job order title, saved-list description) saved in the mru table is treated as untrusted and must be HTML-escaped when MRU::getFormatted() builds the Recent panel links; the decision sits in lib/MRU.php. At the pinned commit the escape is ALREADY applied.

landing_point.why: The summary names the MRU navigation panel, and lib/MRU.php getFormatted() is the only place that builds the panel HTML.

fix_sites.entry_point: Any authenticated page that calls TemplateUtility::printQuickSearch() (lib/TemplateUtility.php:282), with the stored text written by the show actions of candidates/contacts/companies/joborders/lists

O3_reason_to_dismiss: None applies. There is one renderer, and every writer goes through addEntry() into the same escaped output.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Benign Unicode/ampersand names must render correctly, and truncation to MRU_ITEM_LENGTH must happen before escaping so entities are never cut. The URL is already pre-escaped with & (FIXME), so escaping it again would break the links.

O6_input_shapes: string longer than MRU_ITEM_LENGTH (truncated, then escaped)

O7_producer.where: lib/MRU.php:36-67 (addEntry stores raw text); callers e.g. modules/candidates/CandidatesUI.php:772-774, modules/lists/ListsUI.php:192-194

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The href URL is concatenated unescaped on the assumption that makeMRUURL already escaped it. A planted variant could carry a stored or user-controlled ID segment into the href.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The FIXME at lib/MRU.php:118-119 shows the maintainers knew the URL escaping lived in the wrong place.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second panel renderer, for example a title tooltip attribute holding the full untruncated text, could be built in printQuickSearch from the raw rows, outside MRU.php.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The panel uses text-truncate, so a full-text tooltip is a natural UI addition, and it would be an attribute context away from the escaped element text.

services: MySQL/MariaDB (app runtime; the unit tests mock the DB)
O10_build.project_tests: src/OpenCATS/Tests/UnitTests/MRUTest.php (already present at the pinned commit, identical to the fix's test)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap the dataItemText in Template::escapeHtml at lib/MRU.php:123 (the published fix), or escape at addEntry, which would double-escape any other consumer.

out_of_scope_notes: The pinned commit ccd727d already contains f82e0ee's change (lib/MRU.php:123) and its test (src/OpenCATS/Tests/UnitTests/MRUTest.php:1-60). Only the version bump at constants.php:27 (still 0.10.0) is missing, so the pin looks wrong: it is the parent of the version-bump commit, not of the security fix.
